case_specs.r_call: gllvmTMB:::parse_multi_formula(gllvmTMB:::desugar_brms_sugar(value ~ 0 + meta_V(V = V))) -- expect covstructs[[1]]$kind == "equalto" with extra$vcv resolving to V (R/brms-sugar.R:1404 meta_V(V, type="exact") rewrites to meta(sampling_var=V) at R/brms-sugar.R:4546, which itself desugars to equalto(0+obs|grp_V, V) at R/brms-sugar.R:4726-4729 -- "equalto" is one of the real covstruct kinds handled by parse_multi_formula(), R/parse-multi-formula.R:100).
case_specs.julia_surface: No meta-analysis known-sampling-variance family exists in GLLVM.jl. The nearest neighbour, src/families/gaussian_pervar.jl, fits a per-species residual variance as a free parameter rather than accepting a user-supplied, exactly-known per-observation sampling variance V (the defining feature of a meta-analytic model).
comparands: planned GLLVM.jl meta()-equivalent constructor (not yet implemented)

rows.rationale: COV-META-EXACT is public grammar sugar (meta_V() rewriting to meta(sampling_var=)), not an R internal, so it is not a reclassification candidate. GLLVM.jl has no known-sampling-variance meta-analysis family at all yet (gaussian_pervar.jl fits variance, it does not fix it from user data), so this is a genuine roadmap gap: one planned formula-parity case is drafted against the future meta() entry point.

rows.rationale: Already classified compatibility_adapter upstream (a legacy R spelling that rewrites to the same target as COV-META-EXACT); the adapter itself is public-facing sugar, not an R internal, so it is kept as compatibility_adapter rather than reclassified. case_specs.r_call: gllvmTMB:::parse_multi_formula(gllvmTMB:::desugar_brms_sugar(value ~ 0 + trait + phylo_latent(species, A = A))) -- expect covstructs[[1]]$kind == "phylo_rr" with extra$vcv resolving to A (R/brms-sugar.R:753 phylo_latent(species, d=1, A=NULL, ...) carries its own vcv/tree/A argument and rewrite_canonical_aliases (R/brms-sugar.R:2398) forwards it onto the internal phylo_rr AST node). Compare against gllvmTMB:::parse_multi_formula(gllvmTMB:::desugar_brms_sugar(value ~ 0 + trait + phylo_rr(species, d = 1))) -- expect covstructs[[1]]$kind == "phylo_rr" with extra$vcv absent (NULL), because the real exported phylo_rr <- function(species, d = 1) (R/brms-sugar.R:422) takes NO vcv argument -- the original case_spec's literal "phylo_rr(species,d=1L,vcv=A)" is not a callable R expression and has been replaced.
comparands: GLLVM.jl single Sigma_phy call surface (already implemented, name-neutral)

rows.rationale: Already classified compatibility_adapter upstream: an R-side spelling alias with a single canonical target. GLLVM.jl's covariance-matrix argument is already name-neutral (one Sigma_phy/vcv-style keyword, no A= vs vcv= alias split), so the planned case is a documentation/control check that the alias collapses to the same Julia call rather than a new fit. Defect fix: the case_spec's r_call previously asserted a literal same_rewrite("phylo_latent(species,A=A)", "phylo_rr(species,d=1L,vcv=A)") target; the real exported phylo_rr <- function(species, d = 1) (R/brms-sugar.R:422) has no vcv argument, so that target string is not a callable R expression. The r_call now exercises the actual desugar_brms_sugar()/parse_multi_formula() entry points (R/brms-sugar.R:4666, R/parse-multi-formula.R:62) and states the real expected parsed structure: phylo_latent(species, A=A) rewrites to an internal phylo_rr AST node carrying extra$vcv = A, while the bare phylo_rr(species, d=1) spelling has no in-formula vcv slot at all -- equivalent legacy-spelling behaviour requires the top-level phylo_vcv = A argument to gllvmTMB() instead.

case_specs.r_call: gllvmTMB:::parse_multi_formula(gllvmTMB:::desugar_brms_sugar(value ~ 0 + trait + phylo_dep(0 + trait | species))) -- expect covstructs[[1]]$kind == "phylo_rr" with extra$.dep == TRUE and extra$d == quote(.deferred_n_traits) (R/brms-sugar.R:4459-4465: the intercept-only phylo_dep(0+trait|species) branch rewrites to phylo_rr(species, d=.deferred_n_traits, .dep=TRUE); `.deferred_n_traits` is a placeholder symbol resolved to n_traits later in fit-multi.R, not by parse_multi_formula itself).
case_specs.julia_surface: No public Julia route for a cross-trait DEPENDENT (correlated-loading) phylogenetic term exists. The phylo_*_xlv.jl kernels (e.g. src/phylo_poisson_xlv.jl) are explicitly marked internal reduction-tested proofs, not R grammar support ("deliberately not exported ... not R grammar support"), and the exported sparse/contrasts/edge-incidence phylo paths (sparse_phy.jl, phylo_contrasts.jl, edge_incidence.jl) fit a single phylogenetic latent-variable structure without a documented dependent-vs-independent cross-trait loading switch.
comparands: planned Julia dependent cross-trait phylogenetic loading route (not yet public)

rows.rationale: phylo_dep() is the dependent (cross-trait-correlated) counterpart to phylo_indep()/phylo_latent(), already covered elsewhere by structured-required-case-plan reduced-rank fixtures. The internal phylo_*_xlv.jl kernels that could in principle supply this are explicitly documented as non-grammar internal proofs, so no public Julia surface currently exists; kept required_core with one planned formula-parity case.

case_specs.r_call: gllvmTMB:::parse_multi_formula(gllvmTMB:::desugar_brms_sugar(value ~ 0 + trait + phylo_latent(species, unique = TRUE))) -- expect covstructs to contain two entries: kind == "phylo_rr" with extra$d == 1 (the loadings-only term), and kind == "phylo_rr" with extra$.phylo_unique == TRUE and extra$.auto_unique == TRUE (the folded companion) (R/brms-sugar.R:3753 phylo_latent(species, d=1, unique=FALSE, ...) desugars via the phylo_latent branch at R/brms-sugar.R:3763-3785: unique=TRUE builds psi_call = phylo_rr(species, .phylo_unique=TRUE, .auto_unique=TRUE) and returns `call("+", new_call, psi_call)`).
case_specs.julia_surface: Same grammar gap as COV-ANIMAL-FOLDED-UNIQUE: GLLVM.jl's phylo covariance entry points (sparse_phy.jl, phylo_contrasts.jl, edge_incidence.jl) accept a tree or Sigma_phy matrix and a fixed rank K, with no automatic folded/auto-unique reduced-rank loading construction mirroring .phylo_unique/.auto_unique.
comparands: planned GLLVM.jl folded/auto-unique phylo loading construction (not yet implemented)

rows.rationale: Folded/auto-unique variant of phylo_latent(), structurally identical gap to COV-ANIMAL-FOLDED-UNIQUE: the reduced-rank phylo fit itself is covered by structured-required-case-plan fixtures (STRUCT-PHY-*), but the .phylo_unique/.auto_unique folded-loading construction has no Julia-side counterpart yet. Kept required_core with one planned formula-parity case.

GLLVM.jl implements student with the identity link (per src/families/), and random_slopes.jl's family-generic Laplace reuse makes the combination reachable in principle, but the module's own comments scope its validated coverage to Poisson first. Kept required_core; two planned cases drafted — a native random-slopes fit and an RCall.jl bridge cross-check against gllvmTMB on the same family/link.
